descriptionChirho: All four clusters refer to the same person Mordecai (Mordechai), the Jewish leader and cousin/adoptive father of Esther in the Persian court. The clusters differ only in grammatical prefixes: bare name, prepositional 'to/for,' conjunctive 'and,' and prepositional 'against.' Multilingual evidence is perfectly uniform: Arabic uses Murdakhai (مُرْدَخَايَ/مُرْدَخَايُ) throughout; Korean uses Moreudeugae (모르드개) in all clusters; Spanish uses Mardoqueo consistently; Hindi uses Mardakai (मर्दकै) in all; Swahili uses Mordekai throughout. This is one personal proper noun referring to a single biblical figure.
